uc-play-920.text:
Board editing use cases (source of truth: the DS Screen spec, screens.md. ※ marks one not yet met)

• Edit-1 Enter ("Edit board" in Play's or Study's right panel, ⌘E. Starts from the current board)
• Edit-2 Place and remove discs (choose Black / White / Erase, then press or drag. A press that starts on a disc of the same color erases)
• Edit-3 Revert (⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z. One drag or one button press is one step)
• Edit-4 Change everything at once (start position, clear, swap colors)
• Edit-5 Start ("Play from here" / "Open in study". If the side to move has no legal move, it starts with a pass)
• Edit-6 Quit (Cancel, Esc, or move to another screen)

local.text:
Rules for Play, Study and Book (local screens)

• Play and Study show the same game record. "New game" asks to confirm only on a board with at least one move (it clears both). It cannot be pressed while thinking
• "Start game" ⇄ "Stop game" (danger). Leaving the Play screen pauses the game; "Start game" resumes it. During a game, moving to a past move in the game record table pauses; playing there continues (no confirm)
• Take back goes to just before your own previous move (KUROOBI's moves and passes in between go back too). It cannot be pressed with no moves or while thinking
• The main time runs only during a game. Taking back or going back in the game record table also restores the time left (loaded moves leave both clocks full). The disc-count band shows, on a time control, the time left from before the start; on a level, KUROOBI's total thinking time
• Loading a game record (Open in study, Load, Paste) on a board with a record asks "Replace the record?". At a mid-record position in Study, playing a move different from the record asks "Play a different move?" (the same move just advances one move)
• Right detail panel: one sheet without tabs in both Play and Study. Strength on top (in Study, "Analysis settings": strength and book), the game record below. Strength is touched every time, so it is not hidden. Learning goes to Settings > Engine "Learning" (progress on the status bar)
• Play's strength is chosen as "Level / Time control". A level is a strength with fixed depth and solve; on a time control KUROOBI decides its search from the time left (you get the same main time). The main time is set here, not in Settings. Once a move is on the board, the Level/Time control switch and the main time cannot change until "New game" (the level's step can change during a game). On a time control, both players' time left is shown large in place of the picker (the small time left in the disc-count band stays for narrow windows that hide the right panel)
• Study's analysis settings (strength, book) are separate values from Play's strength
• "Evals" is on both Play's and Study's toolbars, and on/off is kept separately (Play starts off, Study starts on)
• A switch is always one row (words on the left, switch on the right)
• The time column of the game record table appears only for records with times (played in Play). For loaded records the whole column is omitted
• Continuous eval analysis runs only on screens with a board (Play, Study). While analyzing, the graph's right shows "Analyzing n/m", a thin progress bar and "Stop analysis" (danger); the status bar also shows "Analyzing a / b"
• The eval graph's empty-state text sits on a patch of background color over the 0 line, so the line does not run through the text
• Board coordinates are never smaller than 11px on screen, even on a small board
• Book tree: the header and rows share columns (move and marks in the flexible left column, eval and occurrences in fixed-width right columns). Source: only learned moves get a gold "Learned"
• Learning log period is "All time / Last n days" (not the same words as the neighboring "All / Lost games")
• Learning log: the left list is as wide as the book tree, the center board has no coordinates, the right column is not a Dock (it narrows at 1120px or less). "Updated book entries" rows are not for selecting; pressing one opens that move in Study. "Show in book", "Undo" (danger, with confirm)
• With no book, neither the tree nor the right panel is shown, only guidance and "Open settings"
• Learning ON/OFF is saved
• The preview when loading a game record marks the board thumbnail's place with a dotted frame even before pasting

DS components: confirm is Confirm. The analysis settings are Strength in the right panel (LevelPicker was removed from the DS). With a single tab, the Dock shows no tab strip. Book rows and the learning log totals are assembled inside the screens (BookScreen.tsx / LearnLog.tsx)
• Pressing the board before starting a game starts it (on your turn that move is played; on KUROOBI's turn KUROOBI starts moving). With side "None" on a level, "Start game" cannot be pressed (KUROOBI does not move, so there is nothing to start)
• In both Play and Study the bottom of the right panel is "Paste" (⌘O) "Load" "Edit board" (⌘E) "Save" (⌘S). The ways to load do not change by screen
• While any confirm or dialog is open, keyboard shortcuts do not work
• Evals on the board are always from the side to move (+ is good for the side to move). The game record's "Eval" column and the graph are from Black. There is no Black/White viewpoint switch
• Legal-move dots and eval circles are in the color of the side to move's disc (translucent black on Black's turn; translucent white with a white rim on White's turn). Themes do not change them
• Both Black and White in the disc-count band have the same frame; only the side to move gets the --accent rim and background (the counts do not move when the turn changes)

sizing.text:
What changes with window size (minimum 860×560)

• Status bar: the right side (CPU, memory, GGS) is always shown. The left hides items that do not fit, from the end
• Width 1040px or less: the left list narrows to 216px
• Details in Players and Results are a drawer from the right (480px wide; in a narrow window 120px is left on the left). Shown only when a row is selected. Pressing outside the drawer closes it and the press still takes effect (on another row the details switch). × and Esc also close it
• Play: the board and the graph share the height. In a short window the graph shrinks down to 64px, and spare height goes to the graph (max 260px). If the board is under 340px, the rating and notes on the player rows are hidden
• Eval graph: if tick spacing is under 14px, labels are thinned out. A synchro total waits until both boards are in
• Results: with a window height under 700, the rating history becomes 96px
• Tournaments: if the details are under 640px, standings and crosstable switch by tabs
• List rows: from the clicked row, ↑↓ select the previous and next rows
• Descriptive text does not wrap mid-word or leave a single last character on a line

title.text: Screen design: 1 row = 1 screen, state variations to the right
